POWO native distribution explicitly includes Nova Scotia

limits: Host plant records reflect feeding-stage contact, not adult emergence or survival.
POWO lists plant origin at the Nova Scotia regional scale, not the historical establishment status of the specific patch.
No island-port shipping or introduction-route inference.
Evidence for indigenous beach pea and introduced tufted vetch used by one selected butterfly in the same 1983 island survey, not global frequency.
One year larval presence does not determine native butterfly origin, durable breeding population, or endemicity.
If HOSTS inherited the same publication, do not call this an entirely independent larval-host interaction dataset.
